items.title: Zero Trust Agents: Secure AO-Workloads with OPA and Kubernetes #CLC26
items.summary: AI agents are evolving from passive chatbots into autonomous actors that can independently alter system states. This ‘capacity to act’ carries risks such as tool misuse and PII leakage.In this talk, we present a cloud-native reference architecture for Kubernetes that secures agent-based workloads.We demonstrate how the Open Policy Agent (OPA) enforces fine-grained ‘policy-as-code’ validation before every tool invocation via callback hooks and other appropriate mechanisms. We also use CNCF tools for real-time sanitisation of sensitive data. And we outline a ‘Zero Trust Agent’ architecture that combines LLM flexibility with strict compliance guarantees.
